question: In March 2022, who unveiled a new brand 'VIDA' for its emerging mobility solutions and upcoming electric vehicles?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hero Motocorp**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Hero Motocorp** unveiled a new brand 'VIDA' for its emerging mobility solutions and upcoming electric vehicles in March 2022.
 
• 'VIDA' aims to offer a comprehensive range of electric mobility solutions that are sustainable and innovative.
 
• The brand launch is part of Hero Motocorp's vision to lead the future of mobility with cutting-edge technology and eco-friendly products.
 
• Hero Motocorp is one of the world's largest two-wheeler manufacturers and has been expanding its portfolio to include electric vehicles.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hero Motocorp** was founded in 1984 and is headquartered in New Delhi, India.
 
• The company has a strong presence in over 40 countries across Asia, Africa, and South and Central America.
 
• Hero Motocorp has consistently been at the forefront of innovation, introducing various models and technologies that cater to diverse customer needs.
 
• The launch of 'VIDA' aligns with the global trend towards sustainable transportation and the increasing demand for electric vehicles.
 
• With the introduction of 'VIDA', Hero Motocorp aims to contribute significantly to reducing carbon emissions and promoting green mobility.
